text: This report summarizes the discussions at the Tenant Liaison Consultation meeting held on March 21, 2018. Leading the meeting was the Co-host Councillor Karygiannis. Exhibition Place staff in attendance included Dianne Young, CEO, Gilles Bouchard, Director of Event Management; Ron Kostick, Tenant Coordinator; Hardat Persaud, CFO and Corporate Secretary; Tony Porter, Director, Security and Parking; and Jennifer Foster, Administrative Assistant to SEM GM. Thirteen tenants were present representing the following organizations: RAWF; Liberty Grand; Toronto Event Centre; Fashion Incubator; Parks, Forestry and Recreation; CNEA; Maple Leaf Sports and Entertainment; Toronto Police Mounted Unit; Emergency Medical Services; Queen Elizabeth Theatre; Fountainblu Dining Room; and Hotel X.
